Photogrammetry in wild birds

1 Load required packages

library(ggplot2) # for plotting
library(cowplot) # for plotting arrangement
library(dplyr) # data handling
library(tidyr) # data handling
library(purrr) # data handling
library(ggrepel) # plotting layout
library(car) # anova
library(FD) # functional diversity
library(funspace) # functional trait space
library(nlme) # generalized least squares
library(here) # path reproducibility

2 Load data

# Field measures
field_measures <- read.table(here("data", "field measurements.txt"), head = T)
sp <- unique(field_measures$Species)

# AVONET database
avo <- read.delim(here("data", "AVONET_birdtree.txt"))
avo.sp <- avo[avo$Species %in% sp, ]

3 Exploratory analyses

# Means per species
means.avo <- avo.sp %>% group_by(Species) %>% 
  summarise(Beak.Length_Culmen = mean(Beak.Length_Culmen, na.rm = T),
            Tarsus.Length = mean(Tarsus.Length, na.rm = T),
            Wing.Length = mean(Wing.Length, na.rm = T))

means.field <- field_measures %>% group_by(Species) %>% 
  summarise(Beak.Length_Culmen = mean(corr_bill_length_mm, na.rm = T),
            Tarsus.Length = mean(corr_tarsus_length_mm, na.rm = T),
            Wing.Length = mean(corr_wing_length_mm, na.rm = T))

means_measures <- data.frame(means.avo, means.field)

# Plots between field and AVONET measurements
p1 <- ggplot(data = means_measures, aes(x = Beak.Length_Culmen, 
                                  y = Beak.Length_Culmen.1)) +
  geom_point() + xlab("Mean bill length (AVONET) (mm)") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, 
              color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  ylab("Mean bill length (photographs) (mm)")

p2 <- ggplot(data = means_measures, aes(x = Tarsus.Length, 
                                  y = Tarsus.Length.1)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, 
              color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  xlab("Mean tarsus length (AVONET) (mm)") +
  ylab("Mean tarsus length (photographs) (mm)")

p3 <- ggplot(data = means_measures, aes(x = Wing.Length, 
                                  y = Wing.Length.1)) +
  geom_point() + xlab("Mean wing length (AVONET) (mm)") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, 
              color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  ylab("Mean wing length (photographs) (mm)") +
  ylim(0,100)

plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, nrow = 1, ncol = 3)

    method = "spearman")
## [1] 0.9163883
cor(means_measures$Tarsus.Length, 
    means_measures$Tarsus.Length.1, use = "complete.obs",
    method = "spearman")
## [1] 0.8431373
cor(means_measures$Wing.Length, 
    means_measures$Wing.Length.1, use = "complete.obs",
    method = "spearman")
## [1] 0.888989
# Deviations from the 1:1 line
mBill <- lm(Beak.Length_Culmen.1 ~ Beak.Length_Culmen, 
            data = means_measures)
linearHypothesis(mBill, c("(Intercept) = 0", 
                          "Beak.Length_Culmen = 1"))

4 Functional diversity metrics comparison

4.1 Wild birds vs AVONET

set.seed(664)
field_measures$survey_number <- as.factor(field_measures$survey_number)
rownames(field_measures) <- make.names(field_measures$Species, unique = T)

# Functional diversity from field photographs (observed)
trait_matrix <- na.omit(scale(field_measures[, 15:17]))
pca <- princomp(trait_matrix, cor = T)
trait_space_obs <- funspace(x = pca, PCs = c(1,2), n_divisions = 300)
plot(x = trait_space_obs, #5x5 in
     quant.plot = F, # Plot quantile lines
     globalContour = F,
     pnt = T, pnt.cex = 1.5, pnt.col = rgb(0, 0, 0, alpha = 0.2))

FRic_obs <- trait_space_obs$FD$global$FRich
FDiv_obs <-trait_space_obs$FD$global$FDiv
FRic_obs # Functional richness
## [1] 32.84646
FDiv_obs # Functional divergence
## [1] 0.6417229
# Bootstrapping from AVONET (simulations)
nsim <- 500 # Number of simulated assemblages

names.matrix <- rownames(trait_matrix)
sp <- gsub("\\..*","", names.matrix) # remove points and numbers after points
sample_sizes <- table(sp)

avo.sp <- avo[avo$Species %in% sp, ]
avo.sp$Species <- as.factor(avo.sp$Species)
avo.sp <- avo.sp[, c(2,4,8:9)]

FD_avo <- matrix(NA, nrow = nsim, ncol = 2)

for(i in 1:nsim){
  # Sample the same species from AVONET as those observed in the assemblage
  sample_list <- vector("list", length(sample_sizes))
  for(j in 1:length(sample_sizes)){
    sp_avo <- subset(na.omit(avo.sp), Species == names(sample_sizes[j]))
    sample_list[[j]] <- sp_avo[sample(1:nrow(sp_avo), size = sample_sizes[j], replace = T), ]
  }
  
  # Combine sampled species into a single dataframe
  rand_traits <- do.call("rbind", sample_list)
  rownames(rand_traits) <- make.names(rand_traits$Species, unique = T)
  
  # Compute functional diversity and store the results
  pca <- princomp(rand_traits[,-1], cor = T)
  trait_space <- funspace(x = pca, 
                          PCs = c(1,2), n_divisions = 300)
  
  FD_avo[i, 1] <- trait_space$FD$global$FRich
  FD_avo[i, 2] <- trait_space$FD$global$FDiv
}

colnames(FD_avo) <- c("FRic", "FDiv")

# Histogram of simulated values
p1 <- ggplot(data = FD_avo, aes(x = FRic)) + # 4x3.5 in
  geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill="white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = FRic_obs, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1, col = "blue") + xlab("Functional richness")

p2 <- ggplot(data = FD_avo, aes(x = FDiv)) + 
  geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill="white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = FDiv_obs, linetype = "dashed", size = 1, col = "blue") + ylab("Functional divergence")
## Warning: Using `size` aesthetic for lines was deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0.
## ℹ Please use `linewidth` instead.
## This warning is displayed once every 8 hours.
## Call `lifecycle::last_lifecycle_warnings()` to see where this warning was
## generated.
plot_grid(p1, p2, nrow = 1, ncol = 2)
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.
## `stat_bin()` using `bins = 30`. Pick better value with `binwidth`.

# P-values
mean(FD_avo[,1]) # mean simulated richness
## [1] 31.69423
sd(FD_avo[,1])
## [1] 2.13544
sum(FRic_obs<FD_avo[,1])/500
## [1] 0.312
mean(FD_avo[,2]) # mean simulated divergence
## [1] 0.6822799
sd(FD_avo[,2])
## [1] 0.02997693
sum(FRic_obs>FD_avo[,1])/500
## [1] 0.688

traits <- c("bill_length_mm", "wing_length_mm",
            "tarsus_length_mm", "body_length_mm")

# Function to estimate bias (obs = trait, true = true value, est = data frame with covariates)
bias <- function(obs_values, true, est){
  output <- vector("list", 5)
  
  obs <- est[[obs_values]]
  
  # Compute bias y handle Inf/NaN
  bias_trait <- 100*abs((obs - true))/obs
  bias_trait[!is.finite(bias_trait)] <- NA
  
  est$bias_trait <- bias_trait
  
  # General summary
  output[[1]] <- data.frame(
    mean_bias = round(mean(bias_trait, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_bias   = round(sd(bias_trait, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )
  
  # Filter complete cases
  est_model <- est[complete.cases(est[, c("bias_trait", 
                                          "dist_bird_m", 
                                          "angle_degrees", 
                                          "angle_height")]), ]

  # GLS model
  bias_model <- nlme::gls(
    bias_trait ~ dist_bird_m + angle_degrees + angle_height,
    data = est_model,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ angle_degrees + 1e-6)
  )
  
  output[[2]] <- summary(bias_model)
  
  # Pseudo-R2
  output[[3]] <- 1 - (
    var(resid(bias_model, type = "normalized")) /
      var(est_model$bias_trait, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # Summary per angle
  angle <- sort(unique(est$angle_degrees))
  angle_df <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(angle), ncol = 2)
  
  for(i in 1:length(angle)){
    angle_subset <- subset(est, angle_degrees == angle[i])
    angle_obs <- angle_subset[[obs_values]]
    
    bias_angle <- 100*abs((angle_obs - true) / angle_obs)
    bias_angle[!is.finite(bias_angle)] <- NA
    
    angle_df[i, 1] <- round(mean(bias_angle, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    angle_df[i, 2] <- round(sd(bias_angle, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  }
  
  output[[4]] <- data.frame(
    angle = angle,
    mean_bias = angle_df[,1],
    sd_bias = angle_df[,2]
  )
  
  output[[5]] <- cor(est[, c("dist_bird_m", 
                             "angle_degrees", 
                             "angle_height")], 
                     use = "complete.obs")
  
  invisible({
    # Plot angle vs bias
    plot(est$angle_degrees, bias_trait,
         xlab = "Angle (degrees)", ylab = "Bias (%)")
    abline(lm(bias_trait ~ angle_degrees, data = est), col = "red")
    
    # GLS residuals
    plot(fitted(bias_model),
         resid(bias_model, type = "normalized"),
         xlab = "Fitted values",
         ylab = "Normalized residuals",
         main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
    abline(h = 0, lty = 2, col = "blue")
  })
  
  return(output)
}

# Wrapper to run bias
run_bias <- function(df, trait, species_name){
  
  estimated <- df[df$medida != "real", ]
  true_val <- df[df$medida == "real", trait]
  
  res <- bias(est = estimated,
              obs_values = trait,
              true = true_val)
  
  angle_summary <- res[[4]]  # 👈 esto sí es data.frame
  
  angle_summary$species <- species_name
  angle_summary$trait <- trait
  
  return(angle_summary)
}

# Loop for every species-trait combination
results <- purrr::imap_dfr(species_list, function(df, sp){
  purrr::map_dfr(traits,
    function(tr){
      run_bias(df, tr, sp)
    }
  )
})
